GIIS campuses (SG-PGL, SG-ECS, IN-NOI) are the original set; five campuses of other brands were added on 9 Nov 2026 from the sample scope nodes in product-truth/01-context/gsg-landscape.md. Campus codes are placeholders (OQ-55); Student ID format is a placeholder (OQ-36). Fields marked restricted are Tier 3. Today in the prototype is 6 Nov 2026.
